name: deepmodebot
tagline: the skill and plugin set for omp coding agents
description: deepmodebot is an open-source MIT skill and plugin set for omp (oh-my-pi), also native in Claude Code, Codex and Google Antigravity. One /deep command routes any task to 30 playbooks and proves the result; a hook blocks writes outside your repo; its PR bots review, fix and merge your own pull requests only after three verifiers vote, on your own subscription.
